changelog:
• Resolved system security & financial loss alerts by eliminating direct sensitive telephony/SMS permissions in favor of standard Android intents with auto-actions
• Fixed silent chat: instant offline responses for greetings and clear actionable guidance if an offline model needs downloading
• Set offline on-device AI as the default out-of-the-box provider
• Enhanced on-device AI model hub with instant 1-tap download for Qwen 2.5 0.5B, Qwen 2.5 1.5B, DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 1.5B, and SmolLM2 models
• Added Android 13/14+ Restricted Settings step-by-step resolution dialog for Accessibility Service
